title: A reference bundle has fixed rank near each base point
statement: Let f:X→S be flat, proper and locally finitely presented, with universally invertible structure-sheaf tensor-pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let E be finite locally free [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Then f is surjective. For every s∈S there are an open neighbourhood U and r∈N such that for every g:T→U, the tensor pullback of E to X×_S T is finite locally free of rank r [def-pc-module-pullback]. No direct image of a second bundle or derived category occurs.

proof.text: Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PicardFiberRankClopen as a proof-only dependency to reuse its private localRank definition, exists_localRank, localRank_isClopen and tensorPullback_rank_iff. These existing proved declarations identify the clopen local rank-r locus A_r on X and characterize rank-r tensor pullback by pointwise membership in A_r. No local-rank helper is restated or reproved.

For q:X_s to Spec kappa(s), compose the given adjunction unit with the pushforward of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit. This is the ordinary structure-sheaf module map and is invertible. Evaluate at the top open to see q.appTop is bijective. Compose its ring equivalence with GammaSpecIso to identify Gamma(X_s,O) with kappa(s). An empty X_s would force zero=one in kappa(s); thus the fibre is nonempty. Transport idempotents across that ring equivalence: every idempotent is zero or one, so connectedSpace_iff_isIdempotentElem gives connectedness. Nonempty fibres also give surjectivity of f by the pullback equation.

Choose a point of X_s and a local rank r at its image in X. The preimage of A_r in X_s is clopen and nonempty, hence equals the entire connected fibre. The tensor-rank criterion gives rank r on E_s. By picardFiberRank_clopen the set U of base points with rank-r E_t is open and contains s.

For g:T to U and z in X_T, let x be its image in X and t its image in S. Then t belongs to U. Pullback.range_fst and range_fromSpecResidueField supply z prime in X_t mapping to x. The rank-r condition on E_t and the tensor-rank criterion imply x in A_r. Apply that same criterion to X_T to obtain rank r after every base change. Empty test schemes are handled by the empty cover.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardReferenceRankNeighbourhood
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (s : S) :
    Surjective f ∧ ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (g ≫ U.ι))).obj E) r
